category.label: Category
category.hint: The list is a snapshot of the provider's catalog. No matching category — type its name and the address builds itself.
category.offCatalog: This category is not in the metabox catalog. If the provider has no such file, sing-box will not start when the config is applied.

format.label: File format
format.hint: The address ends in neither .srs nor .json, so the format has to be named: otherwise sing-box cannot tell what it downloaded.

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.hint: Empty — sing-box refetches once a day. Format: 12h, 3d, 1w.

detour.label: Download through
detour.hint: Empty — straight out. Useful when the source is out of reach without a proxy.

added: Set {{tag}} is in the draft. It reaches the device once you apply the config.

error.urlRequired: nothing to download without an address
error.urlScheme: the address starts with http:// or https://
error.tagRequired: without a name no rule can point at this set
error.tagTaken: another set already goes by that name
error.detourUnknown: no outbound in the config goes by that name
